name: 21904 · Port Deposit, MD
findings: ZIP 21904 (Port Deposit) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21904 (Port Deposit) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
